view.title: C3b — Component overlay: screening boundaries
view.caption: Where does untrusted content get screened (ADR 0009)? A subset of C3a — the screening library and the four edges that cross its three boundaries.

nodes.label: Ingest Test Sources
detail: Adapters: Excel + Octane now, ALM/QC later (C1). Hash-at-ingest snapshot digest (M15)

nodes.label: Acquire UI Evidence
detail: Hierarchy tool: page source, Object Spy, pruned tree. Records device + pool identity; off-pool captures flagged (M24)

nodes.label: Replay on Devices
detail: K runs, pinned pools; dominant cost. Spawns the separate execution process, single-run token, NO gateway credential (ADR 0013). Records ACTUAL context beside requested; pinned-facet mismatch quarantines (M24)

nodes.label: Invoke Models
detail: THE model seam (ADR 0001): P1 Copilot impl / P2 gateway impl, config-selected. Cache key incl. model+provider version (ADR 0002). P2 edge tags = runtime call exists in Phase 2 only; the seam and its callers exist from the first commit (F1)

nodes.label: screening library
detail: Screening library — NOT a component (ADR 0009, amended M35). Boundaries defined by DATA CLASS. Quarantine-and-review failure mode, recorded overrides; flip counter 2 of 3

edges.label: boundary 2: capture output BEFORE it is written (M35)
boundary 2: pulled artifacts at landing, beside hash-at-pull (M35, M9)
